name: GeoAgent
description: QGIS plugin that carries out geoprocessing and map tasks from natural-language instructions.
whatItDoes: Lets GIS users ask for layer loading, selections and processing operations in plain language inside QGIS instead of clicking through tools.
howItWorks: LangGraph agents call LangChain tools that wrap QGIS functions. The plugin is installed from the QGIS plugin manager, installs its Python dependencies on first use and talks to a local Ollama model or a hosted provider.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Local Ollama, or a key for OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic
